subject: MAP Kickoff: Private/VPC deployment — network, IAM/KMS, topology owners
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@aurorahealth.com>, devops@aurorahealth.com
Cc: priyom_das <priyom@redwood.com>, lauren_bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP Kickoff: Private/VPC deployment — network, IAM/KMS, topology owners

Hi Marcus (and Aurora devops team),

Thanks again for taking the call last week. Per our conversation, I’m kicking off a mutual action plan (MAP) to get Redwood Private deployed into Aurora’s VPC for evaluation and to align on a path to close. Attached is a first-pass MAP workbook and a short checklist for required inventory.

High-level asks right now:
- Please confirm who will own network/VPN coordination (name + email).
- Please confirm the IAM/KMS owner (who we’ll coordinate with for key mgmt and any HSM needs).
- Any constraints on topology (air-gapped segments, private peering, egress restrictions).

Proposed next steps:
1) We gather owner contacts and inventory (network ranges, firewall rules, KMS expectations) — target: May 9
2) Technical kickoff (30–45m) with network and security owners — target week of May 10
3) Evaluation window and test plan (MAP milestone spreadsheet in the attached MAP_Aurora_Health_v0.1.xlsx)

If you can reply with owner names and whether CloudBridge (your integration partner) will be involved on the network/VPN side, I’ll assign internal owners and lock a kickoff slot.

Thanks — looking forward to moving quickly on this.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments referenced:
- MAP_Aurora_Health_v0.1.xlsx (MAP workbook, milestones, owners)
- aurora_network_inventory_v1.csv (inventory template)
From: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@aurorahealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: partners@cloudbridge.io, devops@aurorahealth.com
Date: Sun, 2 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff: Private/VPC deployment — network, IAM/KMS, topology owners

Ben — thanks for the note and the MAP workbook. We are happy to proceed. Quick intro to the internal owners:
- Alice Stanton (Networks) — alice.stanton@aurorahealth.com — primary for VPN, peering, firewall rules
- Nate Rhee (Security/KMS) — nate.rhee@aurorahealth.com — will drive KMS requirements and key policies

I’m looping CloudBridge (partners@cloudbridge.io); they’ll help with the VPN tunnel and any vendor-side appliance if needed. Week of May 10 works for us for an initial tech sync — prefer May 11–12 in the morning PT.

I attached a small export of our current network inventory (sanitized) for context.

Marcus
VP, Platform Engineering
Aurora Health

Subject: Re: MAP Kickoff: Private/VPC deployment — network, IAM/KMS, topology owners

Thanks Marcus — great to have Alice and Nate on the thread and to loop CloudBridge. I’ve assigned Redwood internal owners to reduce coordination overhead:

- Network/VPN liaison: hannah_schmitt — Hannah will be the primary for network-level questions and for the VPN handoff with CloudBridge.
- IAM/KMS lead: rishi_malhotra — Rishi will drive KMS integration details, key rotation policy, and HSM questions.
- Topology & deployment: lauren_bishop — Lauren will own deployment topology, namespace/subnet mapping, and RBAC plan.
- Compliance evidence & audit: olga_petrov — Olga will collect SOC2/evidence requests and audit logs mapping.
- MAP document & milestones: priyom_das — Priyom will keep the MAP workbook updated and own meeting notes/action items.

Proposed MAP milestones (high level):
- May 9: Aurora provides completed inventory + KMS expectations (owner: Marcus / Nate)
- May 11–12: Technical kickoff (30–45m) — tentative May 11 10:00 AM PT — we will send a calendar invite if that works
- May 13–20: Deployment window for a quick eval environment (Private in your VPC with a curated test set)
- May 21: Review of eval results and next steps to production or contract finalization

I uploaded a live MAP spreadsheet here for collaborative edits: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1A2b3C-MAP-Aurora/edit#gid=0

Action items for Marcus/Aurora in your reply:
1) Confirm Alice and Nate as owners, or update names if different
2) Confirm May 11 10:00 AM PT (or propose alternate) for the kickoff
3) Flag any compliance constraints (eg. restricted egress, HSM requirement)

We’ll plan to circulate a short agenda ahead of the kickoff.

Thanks all — Ben

--

Thanks — I’ll lead the KMS thread. Quick questions to help prep:
1) Do you have an existing KMS policy doc we can review (rotation cadence, BYOK vs managed keys)?
2) Do you anticipate needing an HSM-backed key (FIPS 140-2 level / external HSM) for the evaluation, or is a cloud-managed key acceptable initially?

If you can drop a short note or link by EOD May 6, I’ll capture the answers in the MAP and bring any follow-ups to the kickoff.

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Sr. Applied ML Engineer (Inference Optimization) | Redwood Inference

Ben / Rishi — confirmed.
- Alice and Nate are the owners (as noted). I attached an anonymized network export (aurora_network_inventory_v1.csv) and a short KMS requirements note: we prefer BYOK and require HSM for production, but cloud-managed keys are fine for an initial eval. The KMS note includes our rotation cadence (90 days) and retention expectations.
- Kickoff confirmed: May 11, 2027 at 10:00 AM PT — please send calendar invite to all.

We’ll expect a short agenda (30–45m): 1) Introductions & roles, 2) Inventory review, 3) Timeline & milestones, 4) Immediate blockers/risks.

Marcus
VP, Platform Engineering | Aurora Health
marcus.lee@aurorahealth.com
